definitions.explanation: Setting free from confinement, oppression, or restrictions.

examples.japanese: {人質|ひとじち}が{解放|かいほう}された。
{仕事|しごと}のストレスから{解放|かいほう}されたい。
examples.english: I want to be freed from work stress.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}{解放|かいほう}{運動|うんどう}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The women's liberation movement spread throughout the world.

notes:
{解放|かいほう} emphasizes freeing from bondage, oppression, or psychological burden.

Common collocations:
- {解放|かいほう}する (to liberate, to release)
- {解放|かいほう}される (to be freed)
- 〜から{解放|かいほう}される (to be freed from ~)
- {解放|かいほう}{運動|うんどう} (liberation movement)

Homophone note:
- {開放|かいほう} (opening up) - same reading, different kanji

Distinction:
- {解放|かいほう} - liberation from constraints ({解|かい} = untie, release)
- {開放|かいほう} - opening to public/outside ({開|かい} = open)
